sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was significantly reduced across all key metrics: Q2 revenue guided down 2-3%, full-year revenue guided flat to down 1%, Q2 EPS guided to $1.76-$1.81 vs $3.10 prior year, and full-year EPS guided to $10.95-$11.15 vs $13.26 prior year. Management explicitly cited negative brand commentary, underperforming product launches, and tariff headwinds as ongoing structural risks. The guidance cuts are material and organic, not attributed to one-time items.

summary.revenue: Q1 net revenue $2.5 billion, up 4% (2% constant currency). North America revenue decreased 3%, China Mainland increased 30% (23% constant currency), Rest of World increased 13% (9% constant currency).
summary.eps: Q1 diluted EPS $1.69 compared to $2.60 prior year.
summary.guidance: Q2 revenue $2.45B-$2.475B (decline 2-3%), Q2 EPS $1.76-$1.81. Full-year revenue $11B-$11.15B (flat to down 1%), full-year EPS $10.95-$11.15. North America expected to decline high single digits for the year.
summary.margin: Q1 gross margin 54.2% (down 410 bps), operating margin 11.2% (down from 18.5%). Q2 gross margin guided down ~410 bps, operating margin ~11.6% vs 20.7% prior year. Full-year gross margin down 90 bps, operating margin down ~380 bps to ~11.6%.
key_risks: Negative brand commentary in media and social channels impacting traffic and top line
Underperformance of certain product launches, including Look of Yoga campaign
Tariff headwinds: 280 bps negative impact in Q1, 150 bps expected in Q2, 30 bps for full year
Fixed cost deleverage from store investments and distribution network
Proxy contest costs and increased SG&A deleverage
Slowing momentum in China Mainland towards end of Q1
Disruption in Middle East franchise business due to conflict in Iran
Softer tourism in Europe and Japan
key_opportunities: China Mainland growth: ~20% annual revenue growth expected
Rest of World mid-teens growth expected
Product innovation: newness penetration targeted to rise to 35% from 23%
Chase program: 20% more volume chased to improve inventory responsiveness
Reduced product lead time from 18-24 months to 15-16 months, targeting 12-14 months
Enterprise efficiency initiatives including AI-powered systems and supply chain optimization
Brand activations: SeaWheeze, Great Wall of China yoga event, summer sweat games

management_tone.label: cautious
management_tone.justification: Management acknowledged 'a few headwinds and a moderating sales trend' and reduced guidance across all metrics, while emphasizing they are 'moving with urgency' but not expressing confidence in near-term recovery.

review_flags.reason: The score is strongly negative (-0.85) based on significant guidance cuts. A human reviewer should confirm that the magnitude of guidance reduction (e.g., EPS from $13.26 to ~$11.00) and the structural nature of risks (tariffs, brand commentary) justify this score rather than a slightly less negative one.
